caption: The video captures a close-up view of a stainless-steel pot filled with boiling water on a dark stovetop, with steam rising. A long-handled metal spoon enters from the left edge, carrying a single brown egg above the pot rim. The spoon and egg lower together toward the churning water while the pot remains fixed. As they descend, the spoon bowl moves into the pot and the egg remains cradled in it. The lower part of the egg reaches the water line and touches the moving surface. Bubbles and ripples disturb the contact area, while steam partially veils the upper background. The spoon continues supporting the egg at the surface, keeping the upper shell visible. The visible handle shifts downward as the bowl enters the pot, but the egg remains held. The boiling water stays active, and the egg stays partly at the water surface in the spoon. The process shows careful lowering toward the pot, without revealing the hand controlling the spoon.
